The key is only restricted, never commanded, so no Existence is needed and the empty FINAL_STATES with the rule-only warning is valid. The environment explicitly allows picking up the key first, so this Precedence is a genuine task restriction, not redundant. Priority is hard, which matches the categorical 'Do not ... until' wording with no preference cue.
